title: SavingMessage
description: Unscored immutable investigation revisions with verified source/interpretation/selection meaning and atomic expected-head publication.

KeptAfterStep.title: KeptAfterStep
KeptAfterStep.description: The incidents and records kept after this step and every step before it, in the order the steps were taken (the measure 'kept after step k', the owner's decision of 14 October): those every one of these steps keeps, a false step dominating an unknown one, over the same parent and under the same request and revision as the selection.

bpic19_prepared_assessments.description: Optional retained declared-prepared assessments. Raw investigation identities provide context only and never identify the assessed items.

revisions.description: The revisions of the investigation, newest first: each one stays as it was saved.

bpic19_prepared_assessments.description: Optional retained declared-prepared assessments. Raw investigation identities provide context only and never identify the assessed items.

IntervalThreshold.title: IntervalThreshold
IntervalThreshold.description: Keeps the incidents whose interval from the first record of the start activity to the first record of the response activity at or after it (the registered pairing policy) exceeds (gt) or reaches (ge) a number of hours on the preparation's clock. An incident without that interval (order not known, no start, no response at or after it) is not evaluable.

VariantIs.title: VariantIs
VariantIs.description: Keeps the incidents whose complete mapped sequence, in the declared order under the activity projection, is exactly the variant's sequence, repeats included. The identity is the hash of the exact labels in order and must match them. An incident whose order is not known has no sequence and is not evaluable.

MeasureBetween.title: MeasureBetween
MeasureBetween.description: Keeps the incidents whose measure lies in the range from minimum to maximum, both included; a null maximum has no upper bound. raw_record_count is the number of raw records of the incident, records without an activity label included, and every incident has it. observed_span_hours and maximum_adjacent_raw_gap_hours are those of the case-list summary (incident.case_summary.full_raw_declared_order.v1): an incident whose order is not known has neither, and one with a single record has no longest gap; such an incident is not evaluable, never inside or outside. Negation keeps the incidents outside the range; the unevaluable stay unevaluable.

PathLagInRange.title: PathLagInRange
PathLagInRange.description: Keeps the incidents that pass the path from source_activity to target_activity, a pair of adjacent records of the activity sequence (the passages of the map's path and of its lag), with a lag in the range: above minimum_hours and below maximum_hours, each bound included or excluded as stated, a null bound not bounding. With passages at_least_one, one passage in the range suffices; with every, the incident passes the path at least once and every passage is in the range. The lag is the elapsed time on the preparation's clock between the two records. An incident whose order is not known is not evaluable; one that never passes the path is outside. Negation keeps the incidents the condition does not keep; the unevaluable stay unevaluable.

ContextNumberInRange.title: ContextNumberInRange
ContextNumberInRange.description: Keeps the incidents whose number in a context column declared numeric at import lies in the half-open range [minimum, maximum), a null bound not bounding. The cell is read by incident.context.number.point_or_comma_decimal.v1. The projection is that of other context: the first record in the declared order, the latest record in the declared order with a value (the latest recorded at the snapshot cutoff), or any record (one of its numbers in the range suffices). An incident without the projected number, because its order is not known or the value is missing or not a number, is not evaluable; negation leaves it so.

query.description: Validated against the registered operation request before save or replay.

selection_prefix_length.description: Verified position in the saved complete-case selection recipe; null names the preparation base. Registered replay verifies the identity at this position.

selection_keep.description: Exact complete-case selection step justified by this frozen parent profile, reviewed activity-measure cohort, completion-cohort stage, interval-comparison side, native association set or recorded-event operator group. Save/reopen verifies the closed selector, predicate membership and supports against the replayed answer.

replay_mode.description: Explicit partial mode omits only registered unresolved source-method gates; it never omits a failed admitted operation.

RecordAttributesAll.title: RecordAttributesAll
RecordAttributesAll.description: OR exact values per original cell; AND conditions on one original record; some raw record must match. Blank cells match explicit null only, absent cells are unknown; negation preserves unknown. Complete cases are retained.

RecordAttributeEvidence.title: RecordAttributeEvidence
RecordAttributeEvidence.description: Nonempty matching or unknown original-row support before optional negation, ordered by case ID then original source position. Absence is evaluated over the complete history; not-matching rows are never deleted.

cohort.description: The reviewed activity operator's cohort over the complete frozen parent.

support.description: One whole-item stage or recorded-completion state of the reviewed cohort answer over the complete frozen parent.
All of the side's items, its known zero-day items, or its items without an admitted interval.

oneOf.title: AssociationSetKeepGroup
oneOf.description: One named set of a reviewed native association comparison, exactly as its read filter names it: a population's items, a criterion's eligible, positive or unavailable items, or a target pair's intersection, union or jointly eligible items.

oneOf.title: OperatorGroupKeepGroup

key.description: The reviewed recorded-event operator answer's selection group key, for example a state, a truth value or the earliest occupancy peak.

oneOf.description: One complete-item selection group of a reviewed recorded-event operator answer (ordinal, FIFO, cancellation, rule or waiting).

policy_id.description: Each Keep names the policy of the reviewed answer that supplies its group: a profile, activity measures, completion cohorts, an interval comparison, a native association comparison or a recorded-event operator.

SavedOutcome.title: SavedOutcome
SavedOutcome.description: A separately named outcome kept with the question: a recorded activity's presence or absence at the snapshot, read by the opening value of a context column. It is asked again on reopening.

SavedComparisonParent.title: SavedComparisonParent
SavedComparisonParent.description: How the comparison's frozen parent was taken: the retained steps over the selection's parent that give exactly its incidents, checked when saved and reopened, or, where no step describes it, its words.

RefreshInvestigationRequest.title: RefreshInvestigationRequest
RefreshInvestigationRequest.description: Applies a saved revision's question to another reading, for example of a refreshed source, without saving: its steps and parent on that reading, and which of its definitions changed.

StageOrigin.title: StageOrigin
StageOrigin.description: Where an activity's stage came from: set by hand, or taken by the analyst from a value of the phase column proposed for the activity.

StagesPresentation.title: StagesPresentation
StagesPresentation.description: The stages of the log the investigation reads, as the analyst defined them: presentation only, bound to the preparation they were defined for. They group, order and colour activities on the map and change no incident, step or count.

RequestsPresentation.title: RequestsPresentation
RequestsPresentation.description: The analyst's reviewed definition of requests and answers for the log the investigation reads, bound to the preparation it was defined for. It finds incidents to read and changes no incident, step or count.
